title: RFC042 durable state and RFC043 vaults merged locally before continuing RFC027 MM diagnosis
status: local merge complete; targeted validation passed; not proof that RFC027 MM live path is fixed

history_ingested.required_context: This entry was written after ingesting the full experiments history and after the RFC027 live handoff in item 277. Do not treat these merges as a fix for the live MM/candle issue. Item 277 remains the current diagnostic handoff for the unresolved trading divergence.

goal: Bring the durable-state persistence branch and the vaults discovery worktree into the current local main before continuing the RFC027 MM/orderbook/candle diagnosis, without masking the known MAHI/read-model divergence.

rfc042_branch.summary: Adds state-db backends, logical snapshot bridge, and dormant durable commit/admission helpers. Production engine paths still call the existing in-memory variants.

rfc043_worktree.summary: Adds RFC043 vault discovery/read surface, RPC list/get vaults, Python and TypeScript SDK methods, docs, and perps UI Vaults view.

conflicts_and_resolution.resolution: Kept RFC043 vault exports/client methods and preserved the existing IntentStatusResponse import/export plus get_intent_status client method from the RFC027/MM debugging worktree.

notes: The RFC042 durable-helper dead-code warnings are expected; live block commit and admission paths have not been cut over to the durable variants.

TypeScript SDK tests initially failed because chain/sdk/ts local dev dependencies were not installed; npm install --prefix chain/sdk/ts fixed the local test environment and left no tracked package changes.
Conflict-marker scan over affected source paths returned no unresolved merge markers.

current_caveats: This local merge does not fix the RFC027 live MM issue documented in item 277: validators can agree on committed_state_root and commit_log_hash while disagreeing on MAHI state hash and orderbook/read-model contents.

Superseded by experiment 279: broad local MAHI suites no longer have the known self-deadlock hang and are useful regression checks again. They still do not prove the RFC027 live MM/taker/candle path is fixed.

Do not wire RFC042 durable live paths while diagnosing the current divergence unless the change is explicitly scoped and reviewed. Those paths touch the same commit/admission surfaces under suspicion.
The working tree still contains pre-existing RFC027/MM, deployment, UI, and SDK changes plus item 277. These were intentionally preserved and not reverted during the merges.
next_steps: Continue from item 277's primary diagnostic: audit mutations of order_books, resting_order_mandates, mandates, runtime_events, and trade-history/read-model fields and classify each as committed-block-apply versus admission/mempool/local side effect.
Treat kombat_getIntentStatus as suspect until proven consensus-derived or leader-forwarded with committed receipts.
Only deploy after the MM/taker/candle path has a concrete end-to-end proof: taker crosses MM book, fill appears consistently on validators, market-data ingests the trade, and the UI candle moves.
